row.evidence: bluejeans.com no longer resolves in DNS and Verizon's former BlueJeans product URL redirects to its general Voice and Collaboration page, so no first-party BlueJeans pricing or SCIM documentation can be checked; only Okta's and JumpCloud's catalogue pages still describe SCIM provisioning.
row.notes: New row. The product appears discontinued: on 2026-10-05 www.bluejeans.com, support.bluejeans.com, developers.bluejeans.com, store.bluejeans.com and app.bluejeans.com had no DNS answer (the zone is still delegated to Verizon name servers), bluejeans.zendesk.com redirects to Zendesk's 'help center closed' page, verizon.com/business/products/voice-collaboration/bluejeans/ redirects to the generic Voice and Collaboration page (no BlueJeans mention), and Microsoft Learn's bluejeans-tutorial and bluejeans-provisioning-tutorial redirect to the tutorial list. pricing_page_url points to that Verizon page because no vendor page loads. Okta's OIN app (last updated Aug. 7 2025) still marks SAML, SWA and SCIM with Create, Update, Deactivate and Sync Password, and JumpCloud still publishes a SAML + SCIM guide (token generated in BlueJeans Group Settings > Security). Without a vendor page the plan gate cannot be checked, so status stays unknown. Candidate for removal at merge.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Sync Password as checked (read from page markup); Group Push not checked.

entra.notes: Microsoft Learn bluejeans-tutorial and bluejeans-provisioning-tutorial now redirect to the tutorial list (retired).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud guide limits: userNames max 30 characters; de-provisioning fails if the user has more than 250 recordings.

fallbacks.notes: No BlueJeans-hosted page loads, so vendor docs cannot be checked.
